import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Оставляем только заказы, сделанные до seed_time
    orders_filtered = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time]

    # Объединяем order_items с заказами
    items_with_orders = order_items.merge(
        orders_filtered[["order_id", "customer_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )

    # Фильтруем отзывы: отзыв должен быть создан до seed_time
    reviews_filtered = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
    review_agg = reviews_filtered.groupby("order_id")["review_score"].agg(["mean", "count"]).reset_index()
    review_agg.columns = ["order_id", "review_score_mean", "review_count"]

    # Фильтруем платежи: платежи привязаны ко времени заказа, поэтому достаточно фильтра по order_id
    payments_filtered = payments[payments["order_id"].isin(orders_filtered["order_id"])]

    # Агрегируем информацию о платежах
    payments_filtered["is_credit"] = (payments_filtered["payment_type"] == "credit_card").astype(int)
    payment_agg = payments_filtered.groupby("order_id").agg(
        payment_count=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        payment_value_mean=("payment_value", "mean"),
        payment_value_sum=("payment_value", "sum"),
        payment_installments_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        credit_card_share=("is_credit", "mean")
    ).reset_index()

    # Присоединяем агрегированные данные
    df = items_with_orders.merge(review_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    df = df.merge(payment_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Вычисляем временные признаки
    df["days_since_order"] = (seed_time - df["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days
    df["revenue"] = df["price"] + df["freight_value"]

    # Группировка по product_id
    features = df.groupby("product_id").agg(
        count_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        count_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
        unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        min_price=("price", "min"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        sum_price=("price", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        sum_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        total_revenue=("revenue", "sum"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score_mean", "mean"),
        count_reviews=("review_score_mean", "count"),
        payment_count_mean=("payment_count", "mean"),
        payment_value_mean=("payment_value_mean", "mean"),
        payment_installments_mean=("payment_installments_mean", "mean"),
        credit_card_share=("credit_card_share", "mean"),
        days_since_last_order=("days_since_order", "min"),
        days_since_first_order=("days_since_order", "max"),
    ).reset_index()

    # Добавление оконных агрегаций
    for days in [30, 90, 180]:
        tmp = df[df["days_since_order"] <= days].groupby("product_id").agg(
            **{
                f"count_orders_{days}d": ("order_id", "nunique"),
                f"revenue_{days}d": ("revenue", "sum")
            }
        ).reset_index()
        features = features.merge(tmp, on="product_id", how="left")

    # Частота заказов
    features["active_period"] = features["days_since_first_order"] - features["days_since_last_order"]
    features["order_frequency"] = np.where(
        features["active_period"] > 0,
        features["count_orders"] / features["active_period"],
        0
    )

    # Заполнение пропусков
    features = features.fillna(0)

    # Индексация по product_id
    features = features.set_index("product_id")

    # Реиндексация под entity_ids
    result = features.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)

    return result
